quotes.text: And the thing most people miss is what creates probabilistic VAT at scale? Exceptions. Every exception you tolerate becomes an entropy generator.

takeaways: ViDA moves VAT from periodic reporting to continuous transaction controls, so every invoice must be correct, structured and reportable when it is created.

Dynamics 365 Finance should be the system of record, Power Automate should run a deterministic exception lifecycle, Power BI should make drift visible daily and Azure should keep payloads durable and replayable.
Start small with a canonical EN 16931 invoice model, immutable payloads, evidence packs and an owned exception queue, then scale by adding country adapters instead of forking the model.
hook: The EU's VAT in the Digital Age package turns VAT from a monthly paperwork ritual into a transaction-speed control system, and buying an e-invoicing connector will not be enough. This episode is for finance, tax and IT architects running Dynamics 365 Finance and the Power Platform who need to prepare for e-invoicing, digital reporting, platform rules and OSS. You will learn how to build a defensible pipeline with clear system roles, exception handling and evidence.
